text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Kikuka-sho, Yaeno Muteki 
appeared calm and free of nerves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, watching Yaeno Muteki face off 
against Super Creek, the Trainer noticed 
something amiss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unlike at the Japanese Derby, Yaeno Muteki 
was struggling, unable to ignite her 
fighting spirit.
